lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The approval surface exposes the full reminder payload, but the reconciled and verified states claim an exact payload match without showing the reminder note as part of the user-visible readback comparison.
evidence: src/Prototype.tsx:714-720 shows the approval payload fields Destination, Title, Note, When, and Fingerprint.
src/Prototype.tsx:742-747 shows the reconciled comparison only for Approved, Observed, and Match, where Approved and Observed render title plus time but not the note.

src/Prototype.tsx:773-779 shows the verified receipt with Destination, Title, Observed, Fact, and Operation, then labels the operation as an exact payload match while omitting the reminder note from the receipt.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can be told the destination readback exactly matched the approved effect without being able to inspect whether the reminder note content also matched. If the note drifted or truncated, the receipt language would overstate certainty.
findings.recommendation: Show a field-by-field readback for every approved payload element that materially shapes the reminder, including the note. The reconciled and verified states should either display the note comparison directly or soften the language from exact payload match to the fields actually shown.
verification: Seed a readback where the note differs while title and time still match, then confirm the UI does not allow VERIFIED or exact-match language.
Replay the reconciled and verified states and confirm the visible comparison includes destination, note, scheduled time, and operation fingerprint.

strengths: Relative temporal references are now anchored to the September 1, 2026 Asia/Shanghai fixture throughout Today, source provenance, fact review, effect approval, and history, which makes the Wednesday-to-September-2 derivation auditable on-screen (src/Prototype.tsx:88-106, 449-455, 602-615, 668-719, 920-921).

Fact revisions remain distinct from source evidence and propagate through approval and history with explicit basis and revision markers, preserving the difference between exact-source confirmation and recruiter correction (src/Prototype.tsx:93-107, 294-305, 586, 713, 920).

Identity conflict handling stays safely unbound by default, preserves a no-change path, and prevents attaching the historical relationship or creating a new person while the conflict is unresolved (src/Prototype.tsx:508-526, 796-823).

Unknown, failed, insufficient-evidence, and no-action states remain first-class outcomes with explicit no-write language and recovery paths instead of optimistic success claims (src/Prototype.tsx:730-756, 835-853, 912-921).
missing_evidence: This was a code-only re-review. I did not verify fresh browser screenshots or a clean-tab console capture for the September 4, 2026 freeze.
No executable proof was provided that the destination readback logic compares every approved payload field rather than only the subset rendered on screen.
The freeze packet still lists the separate real-human MX-01 comprehension gate and independent blind specialist packets as pending.
open_questions: Should the verified receipt preserve the approved reminder note verbatim as part of the long-term audit record, or is that intentionally minimized for privacy?
Is the operation fingerprint alone intended to stand in for full payload integrity, and if so, where is the user-facing explanation of what fields that fingerprint covers?
